# Redesign source additions (2026-10-25)

- geoBoundaries PHL ADM2, representing 2020; original metadata at https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/PHL/ADM2/ and pinned source commit 41af8f1. Attribution: NAMRIA/PSA/OCHA, CC BY 3.0 IGO. Original response and SHA-256 receipt are adjacent to this file. Simplification is a modification; historical reporting catchments remain unverified.
- Open-Meteo archive 2016–2020 ERA5 and eight-day forecast context: https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api and https://open-meteo.com/en/docs . Cached server-side for 96 matched polygon centroids with raw-response hashes and retrieval timestamps in map-weather/. History is used only for retrospective ablation. Weather is excluded from the shipped index because it did not consistently improve held-out results. Forecast context is separate and expires after 36 hours. Data attribution includes Open-Meteo, Copernicus Climate Change Service and ECMWF; free API use is non-commercial and subject to provider terms.
- NASA POWER: https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/methodology/ and https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/acknowledgements/ . Four centroid samples (Manila City, Albay, Cebu, Davao del Sur), 2018–2020, cross-checked monthly. POWER is supported by NASA Earth Science/Applied Sciences; its web services work with NASA Langley ASDC. Different grids and UTC/Manila day cuts limit agreement; this is not national or forecast certification. Raw responses/receipts are in map-weather/ and comparisons in ../processed/map_weather_crosscheck.json.

These are coarse public grid/location inputs, never participant GPS or reports. Source-supplied case files remain untouched. Image permissions are separately documented in docs/evidence/image-permission.md. Full credits are in src/content/credits.json and the footer-linked About page.

# External sources

ERA5 hourly reanalysis via [Open-Meteo historical API](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api), CC BY 4.0; credit Open-Meteo and Copernicus C3S.
Manila point from HDX boundary center: 14.59932236, 120.98493761.
Timezone Asia/Manila; Monday–Sunday weekly precipitation sum (mm), mean 2m temperature (°C), mean relative humidity (%).
Only complete 168-hour weeks retained. Weather features use weeks ending at least seven days before each origin to respect the documented five-day publication delay. Final reanalysis is retrospective and may be revised; no operational vintage skill claim.

## Environmental addendum providers

- NASA POWER: [exact daily request](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=PRECTOTCORR%2CT2M%2CRH2M&community=AG&longitude=120.98493761&latitude=14.59932236&start=20150101&end=20231231&format=JSON&time-standard=LST), retrieved 2026-10-25T01:35:07.149Z, SHA256 485611dd0821bea0b575c5d278f8f810dd26285a21a9d8f059c4a973a32c8b45. Variables PRECTOTCORR mm/day, T2M Celsius, RH2M percent. [Provider notes](POWER.md). [NASA citation](https://data.nasa.gov/dataset/prediction-of-worldwide-energy-resources-power). NASA government data; MERRA-2 / NASA GMAO. LST solar swath is not a civil timezone; cross-check only.
- OSM waterways/waterbodies: [exact Overpass query](https://overpass.private.coffee/api/interpreter?data=%5Bout%3Ajson%5D%5Btimeout%3A90%5D%3B%28way%5B%22waterway%22%7E%22%5E%28river%7Cstream%7Ccanal%7Cdrain%7Cditch%29%24%22%5D%2814.331729568000053%2C120.88639543200007%2C14.805291728000174%2C121.15503641400007%29%3Bway%5B%22natural%22%3D%22water%22%5D%2814.331729568000053%2C120.88639543200007%2C14.805291728000174%2C121.15503641400007%29%3Bway%5B%22natural%22%3D%22coastline%22%5D%2814.331729568000053%2C120.88639543200007%2C14.805291728000174%2C121.15503641400007%29%3Brelation%5B%22natural%22%3D%22water%22%5D%2814.331729568000053%2C120.88639543200007%2C14.805291728000174%2C121.15503641400007%29%3B%29%3Bout+geom%3B), retrieved 2026-10-25T01:40:28.950Z, OSM timestamp 2026-05-31T22:37:44Z, SHA256 87dfa95ca89eee2cb8c10d2083894e23df8a47c04033e8d8cac730e09bf68971. [Full query and source receipt](../processed/osm-water-source.json). Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, [ODbL 1.0](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Primary overpass-api.de returned HTTP 406; the documented Private.coffee alternative returned a complete result. One bounded extract; no browser/provider traffic.
- Elevation: USGS SRTM90m via [Open Topo Data](https://www.opentopodata.org/datasets/srtm/); USGS public-domain data. Exactly 24 batches, 2398 points on a 500m UTM grid. [Every exact request, timestamp, attribution and SHA256](../processed/elevation_sources.json). Cached raw srtm90m-grid-0.json through srtm90m-grid-2300.json plus provenance sidecars. API limit <=100 points/request; calls separated by >=1.3 seconds, <1000/day.
- Boundaries: [existing HDX/NAMRIA receipt](../geo/ncr-source.json), CC BY 3.0 IGO, geometry valid 2025-02-13. Areas derived from these official polygons, not represented as PSA land-area statistics. Fixed 2020 population remains unverified.
- Calendar seasons: [PAGASA climate definition](https://www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph/information/climate-philippines), verified 2026-10-25; June-November rainy, December-May dry; not an actual annual onset announcement.
- Biology: [CDC Aedes life cycle](https://www.cdc.gov/mosquitoes/about/life-cycle-of-aedes-mosquitoes.html/) and [container control](https://www.cdc.gov/mosquitoes/mosquito-control/mosquito-control-at-home.html), verified 2026-10-25. Container standing water is the primary biological context; mapped rivers are indirect proxies.
- Flood candidates checked: [UP NOAH Studio](https://noah.up.edu.ph/noah-studio), [UP DREAM products](https://dream.upd.edu.ph/products/index.html), [LiPAD access guide](https://lipad-fmc.dream.upd.edu.ph/help/) and [MGB maps](https://region11.mgb.gov.ph/geohazard-maps/). Portals/maps exist; no consistent NCR-wide, licensed analytical extract was retrieved/validated in this run. Omitted, without claiming such a dataset does not exist.
- Recent weather context: `npm run weather:refresh` caches raw weather-context-YYYY-MM-DD.json with exact-request receipt, exports public/api/v2/weather.json, and persists failed attempts too. One attempt per 24h on the server filesystem; no collection of viewer locations. Any available recent weather is context only; disease observations still end in 2023.
